# Bid the stairs, the closets, and the stain — not the square footage.

> Price a hardwood floor refinish from field square footage, stair treads, closets, stain, and extra coats — then see price per square foot, the share of hours eaten by stairs, and the walk-away number.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
